extraction_note: No source checked out on disk (image grafana/grafana:latest, monolithic Go binary + React/TS frontend bundle). Research sub-agent extracted /usr/share/grafana/bin/grafana and ran strings against it, plus scanned the frontend public/build bundle and conf/defaults.ini.

notes: SURPRISING FINDING, same 'plumbing present but not fully activated' pattern as gitlab.json: the core server binary has the official openai-go SDK STATICALLY LINKED IN — literal strings confirmed in the binary include https://api.openai.com/v1/, OPENAI_PROJECT_ID, OpenAI-Organization header, chat/completions, chat/completions/%s/messages, threads/%s/messages (Assistants API), fine_tuning/jobs/%s, images/generations, audio/translations, chatkit/sessions, plus Go types openai.CompletionService/openai.CompletionNewParams. The frontend bundle ships a built-in Assistant UI: public/app/features/dashboard-scene/assistant/ (AssistantPopoverContext.tsx, DashboardAssistantViewMode.tsx, PanelAssistantHint.tsx, ViewModePanelPromptCard.tsx, plus an assistant-hero image asset) — a 'sparkle hint' popover on dashboard panels that opens an AI assistant. conf/defaults.ini explicitly allowlists plugin ID grafana-assistant-app for the restricted dashboardMutationAPI (core trusts this specific AI plugin by default config), and 38 compiled JS chunks reference grafana-assistant-app. has_ai_surface is 'partial' rather than 'yes' because the grafana-assistant-app PLUGIN ITSELF is not bundled in this image (no plugins-bundled dir found) — the AI functionality likely requires a separate plugin install or Grafana Cloud connection to actually activate at runtime. No concrete reachable endpoint was identified in this pass (there is no live route to trace auth on, since the plugin isn't installed) — ai_endpoints_true is empty and ai_auth_gated is null rather than guessed, consistent with 'nothing is currently reachable to gate.' If the grafana-assistant-app plugin is later installed in a deployment, this finding should be re-verified for its actual endpoint and auth.
